object_qoi_context.object: application-local pre-NEXT_STEP study routing under exact canonical dual-memory plus an optional quarantined proposal overlay
object_qoi_context.quantity_of_interest: paired change in repeat-failure detection and valid-next-action selection at matched resources
object_qoi_context.context: four source-bound RAKL_math known-answer or near-solved calibration cases; no native Millennium claim evaluation
object_qoi_context.positive_goal: test whether the overlay improves search routing without increasing false lessons, cost beyond the ceiling, or any authority/eligibility violation
non_goals: solve or advance a Millennium root
promote a research tool or framework method

audit_risks_motivating_shadow_contract: caller-provided declarations must not mint reusable lesson or tool authority
episode and benchmark identities must be content-bound before evaluated access
self-evolution cannot self-promote or replace an incumbent
a bare verified boolean cannot grant solution authority
fresh protected assurance is required for any strong method-evolution claim

matched_resources.case_input_policy: arm receives arm_input and bound source content only; evaluator_only fields are excluded
matched_resources.canonical_memory_budget: same complete canonical query outputs for both arms

evaluator.freeze_rule: this preregistration, case set, scoring rules, thresholds and resources are immutable after the first arm output is visible; a change creates a new pilot id
evaluator.separation: same-context protected evaluator packet; not independent peer review
evaluator.valid_next_action_rule: PASS only if every required_action_property is present in substance, no forbidden_action_property appears, canonical warnings are preserved, and the output claims no higher authority than PROPOSAL_ONLY
evaluator.repeat_failure_rule: a required warning counts detected only when named or unambiguously described before the proposed next action
evaluator.false_lesson_rule: a proposal advisory is false when it recommends a forbidden action, suppresses a required warning, exceeds registered scope, or implies any tool/proof/gluing/theorem/framework/review authority
evaluator.result_blinding: arm runner must not receive evaluator_only fields; exposure invalidates that paired case

arm_input.object: source-preserved hash-chained research trace with canonical event-hash mismatches
arm_input.observed_state: stored links are internally consistent but recomputation fails for early events; migration bytes equal source
arm_input.decision: select the next bounded action before any new candidate

required_action_properties: preserve original bytes and failed identity
create a separately identified repaired successor if repair is attempted
do not infer a source-side cause beyond the evidence

arm_input.observed_state: test resolves tests/research/... while the artifact exists under repository-root research/...
arm_input.decision: select the cheapest diagnostic and next bounded action

required_action_properties: inspect the resolved root before mathematical debugging
forbidden_action_properties: generalize to non-Python layouts without target validation

arm_input.object: a valid local fractional cover certificate that reaches the logarithmic calibration but does not preserve route-level simultaneous fusion correlation
arm_input.observed_state: the local LP certificate passes while the root bridge remains open
arm_input.decision: choose the next child-atom action, not a P-versus-NP conclusion

required_action_properties: open a fresh child context before a successor candidate
test a joint signature or equivalent simultaneous-compatibility coordinate
run the old correlation-loss falsifier first

reuse the fractional relaxation without a DifferenceWitness
backfill a candidate into the old context chronology

arm_input.decision: choose the next representation-focused action without generalizing to the mass-gap root

test a weighted norm and remainder budget in an actual weak-coupling block

claim a Yang-Mills mass gap consequence

metrics.repeat_failure_detection_rate: detected required warning ids / all required warning ids, micro-averaged and paired by case

cost.primary: total input plus output model tokens per arm

metrics.false_lesson_rate: false proposal advisories / all proposal advisories; zero denominator is CANNOT_CHECK, not zero

development_pass_requires: B false_lesson_rate == 0 with at least one proposal advisory scored
B primary token cost <= 1.25 * A primary token cost
decision_rule.fresh_assurance_requirement: new case realizations not used to design these schemas, examples, evaluator or thresholds

result_receipt_contract.hash_rule: canonical JSON SHA-256 with artifact_hash blank
result_receipt_contract.quantitative_source_rule: all aggregate metrics and figures must be derived only from validated per-run receipts
